findings.actual_failure: The controller is told to author a spec over an existing directory: the row fails open instead of not-dispatchable.
findings.observation: A present spec directory whose spec.md is absent, a symlink, a gitlink or oversized reads as no spec and starts as author-spec; on a slice head it reads as drafting.

findings.actual_failure: A runner verb changes a slice worktree's files, breaking AC-0001's byte-identical rule and the Never-write rule.
findings.observation: A supervisor status call that hits an unverifiable pin check writes .supervisor/security-events.jsonl into the slice worktree.

findings.actual_failure: Following the guidance, the chain cannot get past a merge: merged and complete are unreachable without an unnamed human step.
findings.observation: The guidance says fetch first, but a fetch that moves origin/main makes every verb refuse base-not-default, and the refusal rule forbids touching refs or branches.

findings.actual_failure: The controller stalls or hand-builds an action that skips the pilot hold and in-flight cap.
findings.observation: On a classify refusal the guidance says to take the next action for another slice, which next cannot name while the held slice stays first.

findings.actual_failure: A refusal for a file the contract does not list; spec drift in a contract section (fails closed).
findings.observation: base-not-committed also checks workspace.toml, which AC-0002 and the reference precondition do not name.

findings.actual_failure: A shipped feature whose spec reads unshipped, unless closeout flips it.
findings.observation: The change ships a release while the spec is Implementing with every criterion unchecked.

findings.actual_failure: The prompt describes a state the runner's rules make unlikely; grading still works.
findings.observation: The eval prompt states a next answer that needs unstated Spec map rows to be reachable.

findings.actual_failure: A worker-planted submodule-local clean filter runs as the operator on the next runner call.
findings.observation: The base-check git status recurses into submodules, whose own filter config is never neutralized.

findings.actual_failure: A worker-committed argparse.py runs in the supervisor process as the operator.
findings.observation: The supervisor child inherits PYTHONPATH and the user site, so an empty entry imports modules from the slice worktree.

findings.actual_failure: Worker-influenced text with control or bidi characters reaches the controller and the human report.
findings.observation: The refused reason relays the supervisor's code, owner and detail unbounded and unfiltered.

findings.actual_failure: An oversized blob is buffered whole on every call; needs a human-merged commit.
findings.observation: The standing-orders blob is read in full before its size limit is checked.

findings.actual_failure: A runner that ignores lease.max_slices_in_flight passes every suite.
findings.observation: The cap-from-policy test asserts only the shipped value 2, and the other cap tests bypass main's wiring.

findings.actual_failure: The controller sees exit 1 with no parseable refusal to put to a human.
findings.observation: main catches only Refusal; any other exception exits 1 with no JSON.

findings.actual_failure: The human cannot tell a timeout from a crash or bad output.
findings.observation: An unavailable gates call reaches next's blocked row with no cause.

findings.actual_failure: The human is sent to repair a policy that is fine.
findings.observation: invalid-policy gives one fixed detail for a runner outside the repository, an absent policy, non-JSON and a lease-rule failure.

findings.actual_failure: Slow unrelated slices delay a classify; heartbeat wakes can overlap.
findings.observation: classify reads the whole brief and no verb has an overall time limit.

findings.actual_failure: The lane could time out.
findings.observation: A 22-minute suite joins the shared 40-minute integration job with unmeasured headroom.

findings.actual_failure: Suite setup cost.
findings.observation: Function-scoped full worlds serve tests that need no repository.

findings.actual_failure: A brief halts on an executable-bit standing-orders file AC-0015 calls valid.
findings.observation: Three copies of ls-tree parsing disagree on file modes; standing orders refuse 100755.

findings.actual_failure: The name claims coverage the test lacks.
findings.observation: The test named for gates and classify runs only gates.

findings.actual_failure: Two places to update for one rule.
findings.observation: The verb-set unit test appears twice.

findings.actual_failure: Adds no protection over the behavioural test.
findings.observation: The Depends-on check is a source-text pin.

findings.actual_failure: An extra subprocess per verb; manual cache clears in tests.
findings.observation: A process-global filter cache keyed by resolved and unresolved roots.

findings.actual_failure: A supervisor refactor breaks the runner with an AttributeError.
findings.observation: The runner depends on private names in pinned supervisor modules.

findings.actual_failure: The slice is put to a human instead of resumed; code and contract disagree.
findings.observation: A slice head whose spec directory has no spec.md reads unreadable, where AC-0032 says drafting.

findings.actual_failure: A reader may treat the supervisor's own log as tampering.
findings.observation: The reference says a slice's own state never changes because the runner read it, which the amended AC-0001 no longer promises.

findings.actual_failure: A worker racing the common Git directory runs code as the operator on a runner call.
findings.observation: The filter-name read and the base git status are separate Git calls, so a filter configured between them runs.

findings.actual_failure: Readiness is read from an uncommitted working-tree file.
findings.observation: info/exclude, assume-unchanged bits and stat settings from the common directory can hide a working-tree change from base-not-committed.

findings.actual_failure: A human cannot tell which call site failed without reproducing it.
findings.observation: An internal-error refusal keeps no location anywhere.

findings.actual_failure: The cause wiring can regress with every suite green.
findings.observation: Nothing tests that an unavailable gates cause reaches next's blocked row end to end.

findings.actual_failure: AC-0001's no-other-file limit is unchecked in the one case it covers.
findings.observation: The security-log exception test never compares the supervisor store or the main worktree.

findings.actual_failure: A sparse checkout with a skip-worktree file missing from disk refuses every call with a misleading detail.
findings.observation: base-not-committed now fires on states git status does not report (an info/exclude-only untracked file, a flagged entry whose bytes differ, a flagged entry missing from disk), which AC-0002 does not name.

findings.actual_failure: Text from a slice could reach the controller on an unfiltered channel.
findings.observation: The internal-error traceback on stderr carries exception messages and paths that AC-0002's type-only detail rule and the relayed-text rule never limit.

findings.actual_failure: dispatch.py reads readiness from uncommitted working-tree bytes the base check accepted.
findings.observation: A forged stat cache in the main index hides a modified docs file from both git status and hidden_change.

findings.actual_failure: A symlink to base bytes passes; a FIFO blocks to the Git timeout.
findings.observation: hash-object follows a symlink at a flagged path.

findings.actual_failure: A future exception on slice-derived data would bypass the relay rule.
findings.observation: The internal-error stderr traceback skips the relayed-text sanitizer.

findings.actual_failure: A same-size edit with a restored mtime under weakened stat settings passes unseen.
findings.observation: Nothing fails if the base check's new stat and excludes pins are dropped.

findings.actual_failure: AC-0001's Git-state half is unchecked in the exception case.
findings.observation: The security-log exception test does not compare HEAD, refs or the index.

findings.actual_failure: An unreadable worktree's blocked row could lose its cause unseen.
findings.observation: The no-worktree branch of attach_gates has no test.

findings.actual_failure: A self-ignoring scratch directory under docs/specs can make a row read ready from a spec the base does not hold.
findings.observation: An untracked .gitignore that ignores itself hides an untracked spec from the base check, while dispatch.py still reads it from the working tree.

findings.actual_failure: A human gets a refusal with no cause they can find; behaviour fails closed.
findings.observation: The run precondition and the refusal detail do not name sparse-checkout, index-flagged or info/exclude-hidden paths.
